# Beyond Tech Intelligence

> Beyond Tech Intelligence (BTI) builds practical AI systems for businesses in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.

## What BTI offers

- AI Receptionist Development: browser-first voice receptionists from Rs 24,999.
- RAG Knowledge Assistants: grounded assistants from Rs 49,999.
- Agentic AI Automation: custom-scoped workflow automation.

## Product: Nova AI Receptionist

Nova is a browser-first AI receptionist that speaks Hinglish in Roman script by default, can switch to plain English, answers from approved business information, and shows a live transcript. Customers need a microphone-enabled browser; no phone number or app is required.

Nova does not confirm bookings, send emails, make phone calls, or invent business facts. The public demo is available at https://bti-receptionist.onrender.com/.

## Location and service area

BTI is based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India and serves businesses that want a helpful first response across web and voice experiences.

## Source

For the most current product details, use the public website: https://bti-receptionist.onrender.com/
